messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1: GPU pool us-west-2a saturated, queue length 18.3k, avg token latency 2.4s (> SLO). Autoscaler reports "scale_limit_reached" and multiple failed spawn attempts. Alerting oncall.

maria (sre): Paging tom (oncall). I'm seeing steady queue growth since 09:12 UTC, correlation with rollout v3.4.0 of embedder-model.

tom (oncall): On it. grabbing logs now. Any customer-facing errors?

ashley (support): A handful of customers reported 500s and timeouts on generation endpoints starting ~09:08. Support page shows spike in errors for routes using model embedder:v3.4.0. Escalating.

jana (eng-runtime): Noted. v3.4.0 changed default context prefill to aggressive kv-cache warmup + full-context hinting. Could be causing KV index growth and prefill amplification. Looking at runtime metrics.

kevin (deploy): We rolled v3.4.0 in us-west-2a at 09:00 via canary -> region. Rollout strategy: 100% within 20m. I can pause/rollback if needed.

maria (sre): Autoscaler logs show repeated failures creating new GPU nodes: quota_exceeded for reserved_pool and transient vendor API 429s. Also we hit the autoscale burst cap (policy: max_burst 2). So autoscaler is throttled by both quota and polis.

tom (oncall): Immediate mitigation options?

jana (eng-runtime): Short term: 1) pin traffic to v3.3.2 for affected routes via routing fallback; 2) disable aggressive prefill/warmup flag in runtime for v3.4.0; 3) increase kv eviction to force smaller context. I can push config toggle.

kevin (deploy): I can run a targeted rollback for the model variant in us-west-2a. Command: ```/deploy rollback model embedder:v3.4.0 --env us-west-2a --reason "kv-warmup amplification"```

ops-bot: @maria created bridge: https://redwood-bridges.example/incidents/1745609876 (bridge open)

maria (sre): Rolling mitigation plan: A) throttle prefill on runtime (jana), B) request increased quota/burst from infra (maria + julian), C) apply routing fallback to v3.3.2 for high-latency routes (kevin). Packaging steps now.

jana (eng-runtime): Pushing toggle: ```PATCH /runtime/configs/kv_warmup {"enabled": false, "max_prefill_tokens": 256}``` rolling to us-west-2a now. Expect effect ~30s after rollout to runtime processes.

maria (sre): Observability: creating per-model queue heatmap and per-pool token inflight. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/queue/us-west-2a. Sharing snapshot.

ashley (support): Messaging customers: drafting short note to impacted customers about degraded latencies and we're rolling mitigations. Will hold until we confirm traffic shifts.

kevin (deploy): Started traffic reroute: ```/route set embedder --from v3.4.0 --to v3.3.2 --weight 100 --region us-west-2a```

maria (sre): Autoscaler: manually bumped desired nodes by +4 as emergency (temp). Vendor still returning intermittent 429s; new nodes in progress. Watch queues.

ops-bot: vendor-api: request quota increase submitted (inc-9876). ETA 20-30m.

(90s later)
maria (sre): Queue dropped to 6k after routing fallback started. Token latency down to 1.1s but still above SLO. Some throttling persists due to inflight KV cache state.

jana (eng-runtime): KV index sizes: v3.4 instances show median kv-index 3.2GB > usual 0.9GB. Looks like prefill loop + context duplication: certain requests trigger repeated prefix prefill. Adding temporary per-request prefill limit. Pushing change.

kevin (deploy): Rollback complete in us-west-2a. Confirming all traffic on v3.3.2; monitoring.

ashley (support): Sent initial customer update: "We're aware of high latency/timeout issues in us-west-2 starting 09:00 UTC related to a recent model rollout. We've rolled traffic back and applied mitigations. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline."

julian (product): Please track which customers hit errors (tenant IDs) so we can prioritize RCA and SLAs.

maria (sre): Extracting list from logs. Preliminary: tenants T-142, T-889, T-723 had elevated 5xx counts. Will confirm.

(15m later)
maria (sre): Autoscaler healthy now, new nodes up. But we saw 3 failed spawn attempts during peak -> vendor rate limit + internal burst cap. Need to revisit autoscale policy max_burst and prewarm strategy.

jana (eng-runtime): Root cause hypothesis: v3.4 changed default prefill policy + kv-index representation. Under certain client patterns (long multi-turn with repeated prefixes) prefill became O(n^2) due to duplicate KV entries, causing per-request memory blowup and higher GPU residency, which escalated GPU pool saturation and triggered queueing.

kevin (deploy): Action items: 1) revert v3.4 defaults (done), 2) add safe-guards in runtime to cap prefill tokens per request (hotfix in staging), 3) add canary throttle for future rollout ramp.

maria (sre): Customer impact assessment: 3 tenants had >60s timeouts during peak window, ~1200 total requests affected. Billing impact: small; SLA stretch potential. Need postmortem.

ashley (support): We'll open proactive support tickets for the affected tenants and offer extended logs/RCA once ready.

tom (oncall): For immediate follow-up: schedule 1) postmortem with eng-runtime + autoscale infra, 2) change autoscaler policy to allow higher emergency burst for hot regions, 3) create synthetic test to reproduce prefill patterns.

maria (sre): Logged incident summary and initial timeline in ops-docs. Assigning owners: jana -> runtime fix & unit tests, kevin -> rollout gating improvements, maria -> autoscaler policy and vendor quota liaison, ashley -> customer comms.

julian (product): Please tag the incident with impact level and customer list for SRE/CS tracking.

ops-bot: Incident status set to "mitigating". Bridge will stay open until postmortem linked.

(End of thread)
